description: This file contains test assertions related to auditing, error shape validation, and audit event verification within a FastAPI-based project. It defines functions for asserting the structure of error responses and audit events, as well as verifying audit logs for specific correlation IDs.

classes.name: AuditEvent
classes.description: Represents an audit log event with fields such as event_type, actor_id, correlation_id, outcome, timestamp_utc, payload_hash, payload_ref, and reason.

classes.name: InMemoryAuditLogRepository
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of an audit log repository, providing methods like find_by_correlation_id to retrieve audit events.

methods.name: None assert_standard_error_shape(body: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates that a given response body contains all required fields for a standard error as per the OpenAPI schema.

methods.name: None assert_audit_event_common_fields(event: AuditEvent)
methods.description: Checks that an AuditEvent object has all the necessary common fields correctly populated.

methods.name: AuditEvent assert_audit_logged( repo: InMemoryAuditLogRepository, *, correlation_id: str, expected_event_type: Optional[str] = None, expected_outcome: Optional[str] = None, expected_reason: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Verifies that audit events exist for a specific correlation ID and optionally match other expected attributes such as event type, outcome, and reason.

ctags.name: assert_audit_logged
ctags.signature: ( repo: InMemoryAuditLogRepository, *, correlation_id: str, expected_event_type: Optional[str] = None, expected_outcome: Optional[str] = None, expected_reason: Optional[str] = None, )
